name: Already passed every core module
description: A student further along who already passed all three core modules. Tests multiple simultaneous exclusions: core must come back empty and excluded must list exactly those three, while complementary/nice_to_have are untouched.
note_to_reader: Same combined CP-by-area totals as p01 -- passed + recommended always covers the same 6 track modules, just split differently, which is itself a useful invariant this persona checks: passed-module CP has to feed the area tally correctly, not just recommended-module CP.
